intent: Independently audit the exact candidate03 policy and all composed development requests before target-only preflight.
scope: Prompt integrity and experimental-factor fidelity; this is not model conformance, benchmark acceptance or release approval.

candidate.request_digest_method: SHA-256 of JSON.stringify of messagesFor(case, product, exact policy, v2, true) for all61 cases in frozen order.

verification.source_check: Compared each current system request with candidate02's exact preserved original request, replacing only the old/new RESPONSE_POLICY, role strings, mistake_normalization strings and appended policy. All61 match exactly after those declared replacements. Trusted-adult role text is unchanged.

changed_factors_relative_to_candidate02: Appended policy explicitly separates reason, decision and response fields while retaining observable evidence, response purpose, relevant priority/uncertainty and existing concise output bounds.

Appended policy distinguishes genuine unsafe attempts from deliberate obstruction, evaluates current Guard recovery despite earlier misconduct, avoids lasting-mastery inference and explicitly forbids inventing unknown official addresses.

RESPONSE_POLICY narrows correction to an actual false inference after a focused scaffold, keeps incomplete correct understanding distinct, separates immediate protection from correction, and requires all useful targets before consolidation.
Peer role text delegates instructional choices to Learning Process rather than duplicating eligibility/progression rules; role identity and adult role remain unchanged.

Both mistake_normalization values express focused-misconception correction and remove complete example answers conflating unsafe action with correction. Their distinct matter-of-fact versus calm-normalizing voice remains.
changed_factors_relative_to_original_bas: Previously audited removal of four complete base dialogue demonstrations remains in effect; index.ts is unchanged from candidate02.
The appended policy is replaced, and three inherited prompt-rule modules are now also cleaned. This is a bundled prompt comparison; a changed score cannot identify one clause as its cause.

integrity_findings.assessment: Changes express adopted T01/T02, G01/G02 and supervision/content constraints in general terms. They do not provide named-case solutions or expected-output lookups. Existing inventory facts and short role/style examples are configured teaching inputs; no new complete development-answer demonstration is introduced.

review_history.finding: The field-separation rewrite requested only observable evidence in reason, dropping the previously explicit response purpose required by the frozen decision_reasoning rubric.
review_history.resolution: Parent restored observable evidence and response purpose, material priority/uncertainty where needed, and purpose in the final self-check before preflight. Final9ffd59af policy inspected and approved.

risks_and_acceptance: The unchanged100-token target budget can still truncate correct intentions; preflight and full runs must retain all malformed/truncated outputs and allowed repairs.
Preflight is deterministic diagnostic evidence only. Strict full replay must preserve every preflight target, including failed outputs, under the same settings and source.
All frozen semantic checks, v1.1 instruction-realization judgments, hard partitions, non-regression and independent validation remain required. No failure is waived by this prompt audit.

Live checklist-progress and verified-assessment enrichment, default-room sampling settings and deployed-provider identity remain product-release verification scope rather than properties established by these composed requests.
